set.body: Consumer: PLSNeuro bd-01M1SCVFP7SXQSGMM96NWAAFV2. General BIDS4s capability: typed basename/root-relative-path/entity predicates; full/contains regex modes, explicit case flag and include/exclude composition; bounded JVM regular-expression evaluator (no uninterruptible backtracking), stable per-file inclusion/exclusion diagnostics before voxel reads; exact selected-path query restriction that retains BIDS/companion validation. Linked-root previews must preserve aliases and deduplicate validated physical identity, refusing incompatible metadata rather than merging by basename/content alone. Acceptance: custom/external/overlapping roots, competing producers, misleading names, invalid/empty/broad/pathological patterns, deterministic order, literal task identities, cancellation/resource bounds. Shared types and query restriction portable; filesystem/runtime-specific evaluation may remain JVM. Preserve legacy query API behavior. compileAll/testAll and first-contact public-consumer evidence required.
set.title: Add explicit bounded dataset selection plans and identity-aware previews
